2608.25486.title: PonsRAG: A Pons-Inspired RAG Bridging Cognitive Islands for Coordinated Long Narrative Reasoning
2608.25486.paper_summary: Long Narrative Reasoning is an essential capability for processing and reasoning over complex narratives. While retrieval-augmented generation provides a promising framework, existing methods still face two critical challenges: cognitive islanding and cross-layer evidence disconnection. To address these issues, we propose PonsRAG, a coordinated RAG framework inspired by the biological pons. PonsRAG consists of two key components: Triple-Layer Indexing, which organizes documents into a connected knowledge structure to bridge cognitive islands, and Coordinated Reasoning, which retrieves evidence across distinct layers and integrates cross-layer information into a unified context. We evaluate PonsRAG on four long-context narrative benchmarks, and experimental results show that it outperforms the strongest baseline, achieving a 11.56% relative improvement in average accuracy on multi-choice tasks.
2608.25486.paper_summary_zh: 長篇敘事推理是處理和推理複雜敘事的重要能力。雖然檢索增強生成提供了一個有前景的框架，但現有的方法仍面臨兩個關鍵挑戰：認知孤島和跨層證據斷裂。為了解決這些問題，我們提出了 PonsRAG，一個受生物橋腦啟發的協調 RAG 框架。PonsRAG 由兩個關鍵組件組成：三層索引，將文檔組織成一個連接的知識結構，以橋接認知孤島，以及協調推理，跨越不同層次檢索證據並將跨層信息整合到統一的上下文中。我們在四個長上下文敘事基準上評估了 PonsRAG，實驗結果顯示它超越了最強的基準，在多選任務上實現了 11.56% 的平均準確率相對提升。
